interpretation: A 2×2 comparison of carried-food capacity (0 or 200) and processing rate (60 or 300), three matched initial genotypes per treatment. Every V18 world has 42 inputs and float64 raw-food transactions. These starts therefore differ from V16/V17 founders. Continued runs are extensions, not independent replicates. Population and births do not establish directional foraging or learning.
